_doc: BR-P3 / BR-V5 / OD-6: OBL005, the dead-rule advisory. A scoped protocol
that matches no reported method is surfaced honestly and never as a
verdict: advisory, and ANCHORLESS — file '?', line 0, component '?',
handler ''. Its SARIF projection is OD-6 (a literal '?' artifact URI with
the region omitted), pinned by the rendered-surface family.
Three protocols, three shapes of the message's scope list:
Phantom    -> two entries, printed SORTED and separated by ', ', which
is CPython's repr of a list of strings, not this bridge's
Apostrophe -> one entry containing a single quote, so the element goes
through repr's quote switch (CPython emits " rather than
escaping the ' it holds). A scope entry is project
configuration and can hold any string; the rule that
renders it is the same one cp5.2 had to fix on the
Live beside them: Watched, whose scope DOES match, so the advisory is
not the only thing the family can produce here.
